lines.text: Eli drives to Yellowstone's West Entrance in mid-November, ready for Old Faithful.
Since November first, most park roads are closed to cars until spring.
Here's the fix. Enter at the North Entrance in Gardiner.
The road through Mammoth Hot Springs and Lamar Valley stays open all winter, weather permitting.
Check road status the morning you go.
Eli watches bison in Lamar Valley from a safe distance.
Save this before your winter trip.
